title: Posterior Variance Is a Constraint Map, Not an Error Map: Closed-Form Uncertainty for Radiative Gaussian Splatting in Sparse-View CT
abstract: arXiv:2607.13682v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Radiative Gaussian splatting reconstructs sparse-view CT fast and accurately, and recent work attaches per-Gaussian posteriors to yield per-voxel uncertainty maps. We ask what such a map actually measures: posterior variance is a data-constraint map, not an error map -- its alarms are trustworthy, its all-clears are not. Exploiting the strict linearity of X-ray rendering in the per-Gaussian densities, we derive a clamp-aware closed form that the unchanged rasterizer evaluates exactly in one forward pass, in volume and projection space: the infinite-sample limit of the sampling estimator of concurrent work, at ~8x lower cost. On the official 15-scene benchmark this uncertainty ranks true error on 14 of 15 scenes. translated_title: 后验方差是约束图，而非误差图：稀疏视图CT中辐射高斯泼溅的闭式不确定性
translated_abstract: 辐射高斯泼溅能够快速且准确地重建稀疏视图CT，近期工作通过为每个高斯附加后验分布来生成逐体素的不确定性图。我们追问这样的图究竟度量了什么：后验方差是一种数据约束图，而非误差图——它的警报是可信的，但它的“一切正常”并不可信。利用X射线渲染对每个高斯密度的严格线性性，我们推导出一个考虑截断的闭式解，无需修改的光栅化器即可在一次前向传播中精确求值，并同时给出体空间和投影空间的结果：它是同期工作采样估计器的无限样本极限，而成本降低约8倍。在官方15场景基准测试中，该不确定性在15个场景中的14个上能够对真实误差进行排序。然而，当限制在物体内部——即临床医生所读取的组织——排序能力崩溃（中位Spearman相关系数为0.11，0/15场景通过），且对于深度集成和严格正的log-normal后验结果完全相同：三个常…
tldr: 本文证明辐射高斯泼溅CT重建中的后验方差图本质上是数据约束图而非误差图（其警报可信但“无异常”信号不可信），并推导出无需修改光栅化器、一次前向传播即可精确计算的截断感知闭式不确定性（成本约为采样法的1/8），同时发现该不确定性在临床关注的物体内部区域会失去对真实误差的排序能力。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that posterior variance in radiative Gaussian splatting CT reconstruction is a data-constraint map rather than an error map—its alarms are trustworthy but its all-clears are not—and derives a clamp-aware closed-form uncertainty evaluated exactly in one forward pass at ~8x lower cost, while revealing that this uncertainty loses its error-ranking ability within the object interior, the tissue clinicians actually read.
